findings.claim: The change ignores [MessagePackObject]/[DataContract]/[Key] attributes on T and always uses contractless or surrogate mode. The requirement says attributes on T must be honoured. Ledger L21 gives no preference and says to follow the requirement, so this acceptance criterion is unmet.

receipt_plan.detail: Add an execution test where an external type has [MessagePackObject] and [Key(0)]/[Key(1)] and is formatted via [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter]. Assert the output is an int-key array, not a string-key map.

findings.claim: MessagePackSecurity.GetEqualityComparer fallback was changed from throwing TypeAccessException to returning EqualityComparer<T>.Default. This removes the hash-collision resistance guard for untrusted data and is unrelated to REQ-2129. L12 records a deliberate secure-by-default posture, and L15 says to follow the requirement, which does not mention this change.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the existing MessagePackSecurity tests, e.g. deserializing a Dictionary with an unknown key type under UntrustedData. They should expect TypeAccessException and will fail.

findings.claim: The new attribute is a public runtime type with no [Conditional("NEVERDEFINED")]. L16 records that attributes consumed only by the generator or analyzer are marked [Conditional("NEVERDEFINED")] on purpose, so they are not emitted into user assemblies. GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute is consumed only by the generator and lacks it, which is inconsistent with that convention.

receipt_plan.detail: [L16] Attributes consumed only by the analyzer or generator are marked [Conditional("NEVERDEFINED")]; compare with the attribute declaration lacking it.

findings.claim: The contractless member order is name-sorted and read-only members are skipped, which differs from ContractlessStandardResolver. L22 accepts this, so it is deliberate.

receipt_plan.detail: [L22] Name-sorted read-write-only is acceptable; [L20] contractless by default with an optional surrogate.

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: Contractless by default plus an optional SurrogateType for keys. Attributes on T are ignored. Implemented as GeneratedFormatterCollector with CreateContractlessMembers or CreateSurrogateMembers.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Contractless only when T lacks [MessagePackObject]/[DataContract]. When T has [MessagePackObject]/[Key], run the normal TypeCollector on T and emit its formatter into the user partial class. This needs no surrogate, which was left undecided in the thread.
